title: Verifier — candidate draft says 'no other moisture source'; a 48% reading below a pipe is in the evidence
why: The draft leaves out the one measurement that points away from its conclusion. The verifier is told to look for evidence the draft omitted; this claim must be contradicted.

room.name: Bathroom
room.note: Mould to ceiling. Boxed-in pipework in the corner, 48% WME on the boxing, 13% elsewhere.

observations.statement: Mould was observed to the ceiling.

statements.statement: The surveyor noted boxed-in pipework in the corner.

measurements.statement: 48% WME was recorded on the pipe boxing in the corner.
13% WME was recorded to the ceiling elsewhere.

causation.defect_summary: Mould to the ceiling with an elevated reading at boxed pipework.

remedial.works: Open the boxing and trace the leak.

candidate.title: Condensation mould to bathroom ceiling
candidate.defect: Mould was observed to the ceiling at the time of inspection. Readings to the ceiling were recorded at 13% WME. No other moisture source was identified.
candidate.cause: On the balance of probabilities the mould is condensation-related.
candidate.works: The affected ceiling area should be cleaned, treated and redecorated.

flaws.label: 'no other moisture source' against a 48% reading
condensation stated against the validated cause (leak)
